description: This file defines controller functions for managing NVIDIA NIM containers via an Express.js server, including token retrieval, container preload, download, image pull, start, get image/container info, list containers, and stop container.

methods.name: getToken
methods.description: Handles OAuth token retrieval from NVIDIA NGC for NIM.

methods.name: preload
methods.description: Preloads the NVIDIA NIM container environment.

methods.name: pullImage
methods.description: Pulls a Docker image for NVIDIA NIM.

methods.name: startContainer
methods.description: Starts a NVIDIA NIM container with specified parameters.

methods.name: getImage
methods.description: Retrieves information about a specific NVIDIA NIM image.

methods.name: getContainer
methods.description: Retrieves information about a specific container based on image tag and port.

methods.name: listRunningContainers
methods.description: Lists all currently running NVIDIA NIM containers.

methods.name: stopContainer
methods.description: Stops a specified NVIDIA NIM container.
